task.description: CRITICAL: Migration 057 is broken and causing 255 test failures (down from 414). The problem: migration 057 calls bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash() but doesn't define it. Solution: Migration 057 needs to define the chain hash function BEFORE the trigger tries to call it. The function should match what migration 051 expects. Task: (1) Ensure bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash() function is properly defined in or before migration 057 with the correct 13-parameter signature, (2) Alternatively, simplify migration 057 to only include necessary changes and let the chain hash function come from migration 051/035, (3) Verify zig build test-integration passes 410+ tests after the fix.
